follows: scripts/data/careerFirstClubs.json (Round 784). Its seenNotFixed list is this round's brief: Griezmann's 2009-10, Haaland's Salzburg split, De Bruyne's Chelsea and Wolfsburg labels, Kane's missing loans, the three rows that store a lower bound, and Alisson twice.
rule: A row is changed or added only when two independent sources give the same appearances and goals for the club and season, counted over all competitions as the pool already counts them. Wikipedia's club statistics table and footballdatabase.eu's club career table are the pair Round 784 used; every change below also names the club's or the league's own record (Tottenham Hotspur, the Bundesliga, UEFA) or a contemporary match report where one could be read, and says when none could. Transfermarkt, ogol, zerozero and BDFutbol refused every request (HTTP 403 or a bot wall), so none is cited. Assists move to null (shown n/a) where the figure on the row cannot belong to the corrected season and the sources do not agree on a new one. A new row carries assists null and market value 0 (shown n/a), the pool's convention since Round 784, because no second source publishes either. Market values on changed rows are not audited and are left as they are. Where two sources disagree and no third could be read, the row stays as it is and is listed under keptAsIs.
